build_fft_transform: build a 1D FFT on a tensor with custom length and normalization mode
run_ifft_inverse: run an inverse FFT to reconstruct a real-valued signal from complex frequency data
test_fftn_multidimensional: test an N-dimensional FFT on a multi-axis tensor with specified shape and axes
refactor_rfft2_2d: refactor a 2D real FFT to compute frequency components along the last two axes
summarize_fftshift: summarize the fftshift function that swaps quadrants of FFT output for visualization
